'''Tony Petersson''' (GEMP handle '''Tonyduva''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished '''5th''' in [[2024 Retro League Event 2|Event 2 of the 2024 Retro League]].<ref name="p1425034" /> Petersson also finished '''#19''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: Hunt Down; Light: Hidden Base).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
